description: This Java class 'DittoAckRequestsFilter' is a final immutable class extending 'AbstractHeaderEntryFilter'. It filters acknowledgment request headers by removing internal acknowledgment requests, specifically handling JSON array values and optimizing for certain known header values.

classes.name: DittoAckRequestsFilter
classes.description: A final immutable class that filters acknowledgment request headers, removing internal acknowledgment requests and handling specific header values efficiently.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Filters the header value for acknowledgment requests, removing internal requests and optimizing for specific known values.

methods.name: isTwinPersistedOnly
methods.description: Checks if the value equals the JSON array string representing only 'TWIN_PERSISTED' acknowledgment.

methods.name: isLiveResponseOnly
methods.description: Checks if the value equals the JSON array string representing only 'LIVE_RESPONSE' acknowledgment.

methods.name: isRequestedAcks
methods.description: Checks if the header key matches 'REQUESTED_ACKS'.

methods.name: tryToParseAsJsonArrayAndFilter
methods.description: Attempts to parse the string as a JSON array and filter out internal acknowledgment requests, returning null on parse failure.

methods.name: parseAsJsonArrayAndFilter
methods.description: Parses the string as a JSON array and filters out internal acknowledgment requests, returning a JSON string or null.

methods.name: isDittoInternal
methods.description: Determines if a JSON value corresponds to an internal Ditto acknowledgment label.
